params.name: uuid
params.description: Return the reward with matching uuid.

params.name: campaign_uuid
params.description: Filter rewards by the order with the matching Giftbit UUID.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Filter rewards by the client-supplied order id.

params.name: price_in_cents_greater_than
params.description: Filter rewards with price greater than this value in cents.

params.name: price_in_cents_less_than
params.description: Filter rewards with price less than this value in cents.

params.name: recipient_name
params.description: Filter by recipient name (minimum 3 characters).

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Filter by recipient email (minimum 3 characters).

params.name: delivery_status
params.description: Filter by delivery status. Options: UNSENT, DELIVERED, UNDELIVERABLE, TEMPORARILY_UNDELIVERABLE, UNSUBSCRIBED, COMPLAINT.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by reward status. Options: SENT_AND_REDEEMABLE, REDEEMED, TO_CHARITY, GIVER_CANCELLED, EXPIRED.

params.name: created_date_greater_than
params.description: Filter by created date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: created_date_less_than
params.description: Filter by created date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: delivery_date_greater_than
params.description: Filter by delivery date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: delivery_date_less_than
params.description: Filter by delivery date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: redelivery_count_greater_than
params.description: Filter by redelivery count greater than this value.

params.name: redelivery_count_less_than
params.description: Filter by redelivery count less than this value.

params.name: redeemed_date_greater_than
params.description: Filter by redeemed date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: redeemed_date_less_than
params.description: Filter by redeemed date. Format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rewards to return. Default 20.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into results. Default 0.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. Options: campaign_id, price_in_cents, recipient_name, recipient_email, delivery_status, status.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort direction. Options asc or desc. Default desc.

items.docs: Returns a paginated, filterable list of rewards across all orders. Supports filtering by delivery status, redemption status, date ranges, recipient name/email, and price range.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The Giftbit UUID of the reward (not the order uuid or id).

items.docs: Returns the details for a single reward by its Giftbit-generated UUID.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The Giftbit UUID of the reward.

items.docs: Resends a reward email to the original recipient. Not available for embedded rewards or already-claimed rewards.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The Giftbit UUID of the reward.

items.docs: Cancels a reward that has not yet been claimed. Credits for unclaimed rewards are returned to the account. Cannot cancel embedded rewards or already-claimed rewards.
